data.case_title: Rejection of beach bonfire permit application (Brauchtumsfeuer)
data.title: Rejection of permit application for a New Year's beach bonfire
data.summary: The Ordnungsamt of Amt Musterschlei (official Carstensen) rejects Tjark Beispielholm's application for a traditional bonfire (Brauchtumsfeuer) on the beach near Knickweg at New Year, because the site lies in the "Musterschlei-Ufer" landscape protection area and would disturb nesting birds in the adjacent reed bed. The letter notes a communal fire at the harbour festival ground as an alternative, dated 18 November 2026.
data.explanation: The authority has refused permission for your planned bonfire on the protected beach strip, mainly for nature conservation reasons, and suggests you join the communal fire at the harbour instead. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision if you disagree, either in writing or recorded at the office; the app will show the exact deadline window for this. If you do nothing within that window, the rejection becomes final and the bonfire at that location cannot be permitted.
